$comment: The action-pinning burn-down register, enforced by scripts/ci/pinned-actions.mjs.
Every `uses:` in .github/workflows must resolve to a 40-hex commit SHA. A floating
tag is third-party code, fetched at run time from a ref its author can move after
review, executed with this workflow's credentials. A SHA cannot be re-pointed.
The entries below are the set that was already floating when the gate landed.
Resolving a tag to a SHA needs a network round trip to GitHub, so they could not be
pinned in the same offline change that added the gate. They are registered rather
than ignored so the gate is green on arrival and BLOCKS anything new — the shape
TO DRAIN ONE (repeat per action, one PR is fine for all of them):
# then in every workflow: uses: actions/checkout@<sha> # v7
Dependabot's github-actions ecosystem (.github/dependabot.yml) already covers this
repo and bumps SHA pins in place, keeping the trailing `# v7` comment current — so
pinning costs no ongoing maintenance once done.
`ceiling` counts REFERENCES, not distinct actions — 33 `uses:` lines across 12 actions
as of this file. It only ever moves DOWN: pin something before adding something.
